FISHING LICENCE · SINGAPORE

Singapore fishing licence

Ordinary rod fishing with no more than three hooks does not need the fishing-gear licence. At PUB reservoirs and waterways, fish only in marked areas and use artificial lures.

Official rules ↗

Updated 2026-11-11

Who needs one

  • Users of regulated fishing gear, including nets, traps and lines with more than three hooks.

Who doesn’t

  • Ordinary rod-and-line gear with no more than three hooks falls outside the listed gear requiring a licence.

Extra stamps and permits

  • Fishing-gear licence
    For regulated gear such as nets, traps or lines with more than three hooks.
  • PUB vessel or organised activity permit
    Where the reservoir rules require approval for a vessel or event.

Saltwater

Separate port, vessel and site rules can apply at sea.

Rules visitors should know

  • Fish only in marked PUB fishing areas.
  • Use artificial lures in PUB reservoirs and waterways.

How to buy

No ordinary rod-and-line gear licence is needed. Apply to SFA or PUB for the relevant special gear or activity approval.

Common license questions

Do I need a fishing licence in Singapore?

Ordinary rod fishing with no more than three hooks does not need the fishing-gear licence. At PUB reservoirs and waterways, fish only in marked areas and use artificial lures.

Where do I buy a fishing licence in Singapore?

No ordinary rod-and-line gear licence is needed. Apply to SFA or PUB for the relevant special gear or activity approval.
